prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational style exploration
Asset type: 9:16 source frame for image-to-video animation
Primary request: Create one classroom board hybrid frame showing the gradient direction mechanism for Gradient Descent.
Scene/backdrop: warm classroom or tutoring corner with a large board and a small tablet on a desk.
Subject: Indian teenage learner stands beside or points toward the board; friendly, focused, not cartoonish.
Technical visual: board shows one large U-shaped loss curve with one point on the slope. A thin chalk tangent or uphill cue is labeled "gradient: higher loss". A separate colored downhill update arrow is labeled "move opposite" and points toward "lower error". The board must look like a living teaching scene, not a slide.
Style/medium: warm classroom explainer illustration with chalk/marker texture, clean but human.
Composition/framing: board occupies most of the frame; learner provides scale and emotion; safe margins for video motion.
Text to render verbatim, exactly: "gradient: higher loss", "move opposite", "lower error".
Constraints: no lesson title; no extra text; no logos; no watermark; labels must be large and readable; do not add formulas or unrelated diagrams.
